title: Step in the Query State
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine, let $O$ be an oracle language, and let $c$ be a configuration whose state is the query state of $M$. One step relative to $O$ leaves every component of $c$ unchanged except its state, which becomes the positive-answer state if the query string of $c$ belongs to $O$, and the negative-answer state otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $c$ whose state is the query state
